title: Planetary Sky: Understanding the Colors Above Us · Why read this book?

readerInvitation.reasonToExist: Its journey extends from ordinary daylight to other planets, measurement, and cultural meaning.
readerOutcomes: Readers learn to ask what particles sunlight meets before reaching their eyes.
The book uses that familiar contrast to introduce scattering and wavelength.
Measurement helps turn a changing visual impression into evidence that can be compared.
The cultural chapters add another way to attend to the same sky.
